verification.note: Refresh of 18 Oct 2026. The record rests on VARAM's English press release of 25 February 2025 (varam.gov.lv, stored 12 Oct 2026, unchanged on 18 Oct 2026), an announcement, and on the Commission's page of single points of contact for market surveillance under the AI Act (last updated 7 September 2026). The release confirms the title, the report's preparation by VARAM, the Cabinet's consideration on 25 February 2025 and the designated authorities, as another official source would (level B). The summary and notes are written from the release, not from the report. The report itself, a Word file of 2025 on the Cabinet's legal-acts portal TAP (file 24-TA-2633), was requested in this run, but the portal's robots.txt does not allow automated downloads, so it is not stored.

open_questions: The report's own text is not stored: the TAP portal's robots.txt does not allow the archiver to download it. A person could provide the version the Cabinet considered on 25 February 2025 (AGENTS.md section 7.8); with it, or with the Cabinet's protocol decision for that sitting, the record could rest on the instrument's own text. Until then it rests on VARAM's release and is level B.
